title: Design System: Smart Proxy Route Helper

motion.name: routing-switch-thumb
motion.purpose: Moves the existing device routing switch thumb.

components.name: Options button
components.description: Native action control with explicit label.
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;min-height:38px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 28%,Canvas);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;background:ButtonFace;color:ButtonText;cursor:pointer}.ds-button:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 48%,Canvas)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#245bc4,#9dbdff);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Connection input
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.ds-field input{font:inherit;min-height:38px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 28%,Canvas);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 10px;background:Canvas;color:CanvasText}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#245bc4,#9dbdff);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Route selector
components.description: Selects the list for editing/testing; it does not activate a mode.
components.css: .ds-route{display:grid;gap:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:13px}.ds-route select{font:inherit;width:100%;min-height:38px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 24%,Canvas);border-radius:6px;background:Canvas;color:CanvasText}.ds-route select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#245bc4,#9dbdff);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Configured route status
components.description: Text and indicator communicate configured intent without claiming availability.
components.html:
Configured route: Life · DIRECT
example.org · DIRECT · OS VPN can still apply
components.css: .ds-status{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 18%,Canvas);border-radius:6px;padding:10px;color:color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 80%,Canvas)}.ds-status strong{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:15px;color:CanvasText}.ds-status span{width:12px;height:12px;flex:0 0 12px;border:2px solid #2563b8;border-radius:50%;background:#2563b8}.ds-status div{margin-top:5px}

components.name: Rule row
components.description: Domain and scope metadata with explicit edit/remove controls.
components.css: .ds-rule{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 16%,Canvas);border-radius:6px}.ds-meta{margin-top:4px;font-size:13px;color:color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 64%,Canvas)}.ds-rule button{font:inherit;min-height:38px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 28%,Canvas);border-radius:6px;background:ButtonFace;color:ButtonText}.ds-rule button:hover{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,CanvasText 48%,Canvas)}.ds-rule button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#245bc4,#9dbdff);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The incumbent system uses browser-native surfaces, system typography and compact, labeled controls.
Color explains routing state; text carries the decision. The extension is an operational tool with
English and Russian interfaces, rather than a promotional surface.

The current implementation is evidenced by `src/popup/popup.html`, `src/options/options.html`,
`src/popup/popup.ts` and `src/proxy/routeHealth.ts`. Parent-reported visual inspection covered the
English Popup and Options in isolated Chrome. This record does not establish dark-mode contrast
compliance, Russian layout verification or screen-reader verification.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: A configured route, the actual Chrome Proxy/PAC state and a user-invoked availability result are separate facts. A route color must not imply successful network/TLS testing.

dos: Do preserve native controls, visible labels, keyboard outlines and text-based state explanations.
Do distinguish the selected editing/testing list from the current site's effective rule.
Do keep all route lists simultaneously active and make global Pause the explicit global control.
Do preserve compact summaries while allowing diagnostics, previews and rule lists to scroll.
donts: Don't use color alone to communicate routing, control loss, certificate errors or test outcomes.
Don't show saved proxy settings or an HTTP-only response as proof that HTTPS is healthy.
Don't introduce remote fonts/assets or executable resources into these extension surfaces.
